clue.text: Speed to gain stronghold

taken as written

explanation.definitionFit: A fedora is a soft felt hat with a brim and a lengthwise crease in the crown.

taken as written

clue.text: Iridescent stuff from northern area

clue.text: Greedy beast eats the others, point that achieves renown.
